technology.summary: As Anthropic prepares for its public debut, its IPO filing warns of "catastrophic" AI risks, including the potential for its AI to pose an existential threat to humanity. The company is also facing mounting losses, despite rapid growth. Meanwhile, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says the company won't go public until it can make better promises about model safety. As President Donald Trump prepares to meet tech and AI CEOs in Washington, Rep. Ro Khanna (D-CA) is calling for a treaty between the US and China to prevent AI from causing global havoc.

finance.summary:
Today's most important finance news includes the MSCI Asia Pacific Index climbing 0.6% with stocks in Japan and South Korea gaining. This came after gains for a key gauge of US semiconductor shares, while President Donald Trump rejected regulations on artificial intelligence.

In India, the Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex hit six-month lows, with the Nifty 50 seeing a drop of 64.05 points, or 0.28%, closing at 22,716.20. The benchmark Sensex and Nifty have both experienced significant declines in dollar terms this year, with foreign investors less interested in Indian equities due to various global factors.

In other news, Shapoorji Pallonji Group plans to generate $125 million through a tap issue of current dollar bonds, targeting ₹3,250 crore via unrated rupee-denominated bonds for refinancing purposes. KPIT Technologies faces a substantial 24% decline in stock value, predominantly due to obstacles in the automotive sector.

Legacy fund houses outperformed newer asset management companies in four out of six categories, according to a Mint analysis.

politics.summary:
The Maharashtra Government has unveiled a Fodder Development Policy to tackle a shortage.

Governance must change for the age of AI, according to Chandrababu Naidu, who says the next 20 years are crucial for India.

Congress has sought a discussion on CS and Law Secretary letters in the J&K Assembly, while BJP legislators staged a walkout over the Statehood resolution.

The Supreme Court will hear a West Bengal plea against bail to a Nandigram Congress candidate on October 5.

The Kerala HC has directed transparency in the selection of Sabarimala and Malikappuram Melsanthis.

The Keralam government has forwarded proposals by film bodies to departments concerned ahead of finalising a draft industry policy for Malayalam cinema.
